id-20260815-intro-real-estate-12.title: [Property #12] Rent Income Rp 12 Million a Month, Why Is My Wallet Still Dry?

segments.src: > Properti bukan dinilai dari harganya, tapi dari arus kas bersih yang dihasilkannya — dan utang bisa melipatgandakan hasil itu ke dua arah: naik maupun turun.
segments.tr: > Property is not valued by its price, but by the net cash flow it generates — and debt can multiply that result in two directions: up or down.

segments.src: Banyak orang menilai properti dengan satu pertanyaan: "Nanti harganya naik berapa?"
segments.tr: Many people evaluate property with one question: "How much will the price go up later?"

segments.src: Analisis investasi properti mengganti pertanyaan itu dengan tiga pertanyaan yang lebih bisa dihitung.
segments.tr: Property investment analysis replaces that question with three more quantifiable questions.

segments.src: Berapa uang bersih yang benar-benar masuk setiap tahun?**
segments.tr: How much net cash actually comes in every year?**

segments.src: Ada kamar kosong, ada penyewa telat bayar, ada listrik area umum, PBB, perawatan, dan gaji penjaga.
segments.tr: There are vacant rooms, late-paying tenants, common area electricity, property taxes (PBB), maintenance, and security guard salaries.

segments.src: Setelah semua itu dikurangi — tapi **sebelum** cicilan bank dan pajak penghasilan — angkanya disebut **NOI** (*Net Operating Income*).
segments.tr: After all that is deducted — but **before** bank installments and income tax — the figure is called **NOI** (*Net Operating Income*).

segments.src: Alasannya: NOI mengukur kualitas **propertinya**, bukan kualitas **pinjaman Anda**.
segments.tr: The reason: NOI measures the quality of the **property**, not the quality of **your loan**.

segments.src: Dua orang membeli ruko yang sama, NOI-nya sama, walau yang satu tunai dan yang satu KPR.
segments.tr: Two people buy the same shophouse, the NOI is the same, even if one is cash and the other is a mortgage (KPR).

segments.src: Berapa imbal hasilnya dibanding uang yang dikeluarkan?**
segments.tr: What is the return compared to the money spent?**

segments.src: Ada dua ukuran yang sering tertukar:
segments.tr: There are two measures that are often confused:

segments.src: Cap rate      = NOI ÷ total nilai investasi
segments.tr: Cap rate      = NOI ÷ total nilai investasi

segments.src: Cash-on-cash  = arus kas setelah cicilan ÷ modal sendiri (DP + biaya)
segments.tr: Cash-on-cash  = arus kas setelah cicilan ÷ modal sendiri (DP + biaya)

segments.src: Cap rate menjawab: "seberapa produktif aset ini, terlepas dari cara membayarnya?"
segments.tr: Cap rate answers: "how productive is this asset, regardless of how it is paid for?"

segments.src: Cash-on-cash menjawab: "berapa persen uang tunai saya sendiri kembali tahun ini?"
segments.tr: Cash-on-cash answers: "what percentage of my own cash is returned this year?"
What is the effect of debt (leverage)?**

segments.src: Aturan mainnya satu kalimat: **selama cap rate lebih tinggi dari bunga pinjaman, utang menaikkan imbal hasil modal Anda; begitu bunga melampaui cap rate, utang justru menggerogotinya.**
segments.tr: The rule of the game is one sentence: **as long as the cap rate is higher than the loan interest, debt increases your return on equity; once the interest exceeds the cap rate, debt actually erodes it.**

segments.src: ROE ≈ cap rate + (cap rate − bunga) × (utang ÷ modal sendiri)
segments.tr: ROE ≈ cap rate + (cap rate − bunga) × (utang ÷ modal sendiri)
Pay attention to the `(cap rate − interest)` part.

segments.src: Kalau selisihnya positif, ia dikalikan rasio utang — makin besar utang, makin besar untungnya.
segments.tr: If the difference is positive, it is multiplied by the debt ratio — the larger the debt, the greater the profit.

segments.src: Kalau selisihnya negatif, pengali yang sama bekerja melawan Anda.
segments.tr: If the difference is negative, the same multiplier works against you.

segments.src: Leverage tidak menciptakan keuntungan; ia hanya memperbesar apa pun yang sudah ada, termasuk kerugian.
segments.tr: Leverage does not create profit; it only magnifies whatever is already there, including losses.

segments.src: Bayangkan Anda membeli **kos-kosan 12 kamar dekat kampus di Depok**.
segments.tr: Imagine you buy a **12-room boarding house near a campus in Depok**.

segments.src: Harga rumah Rp 950 juta, ditambah BPHTB, notaris, dan renovasi awal Rp 50 juta.
segments.tr: The house price is Rp 950 million, plus BPHTB, notary fees, and initial renovation of Rp 50 million.

segments.src: Tarif sewa Rp 1 juta per kamar per bulan.
segments.tr: Rent rate is Rp 1 million per room per month.

segments.src: | Sewa kotor potensial (12 × 1 jt × 12 bln) | Rp 144.000.000 |
| Biaya operasional (listrik/air umum, wifi, penjaga, perawatan, PBB, asuransi) | − Rp 39.600.000 |
segments.tr: | Operating expenses (common electricity/water, wifi, guard, maintenance, PBB, insurance) | − Rp 39,600,000 |

segments.src: **Skenario A — beli tunai.** Modal Rp 1 miliar, arus kas Rp 90 juta.
segments.tr: **Scenario A — buy cash.** Capital Rp 1 billion, cash flow Rp 90 million.

segments.src: **Skenario B — KPR 60% dengan bunga fixed 7%, tenor 15 tahun.** Anda pinjam Rp 600 juta, modal sendiri Rp 400 juta.
segments.tr: **Scenario B — 60% mortgage with 7% fixed interest, 15-year tenor.** You borrow Rp 600 million, own capital Rp 400 million.

segments.src: Cicilan sekitar Rp 5,4 juta/bulan atau **Rp 64,7 juta/tahun**.
segments.tr: Installment is about Rp 5.4 million/month or **Rp 64.7 million/year**.
Wait, why did it drop from 9%?

segments.src: Di sinilah orang sering salah baca.
segments.tr: This is where people often misread.

segments.src: Dari cicilan Rp 64,7 juta itu, hanya sekitar Rp 41,5 juta yang benar-benar hilang sebagai bunga; sisanya ±Rp 23 juta adalah **cicilan pokok** — uang Anda sendiri yang berpindah dari rekening ke ekuitas properti.
segments.tr: Of that Rp 64.7 million installment, only about Rp 41.5 million is truly lost as interest; the rest, ±Rp 23 million, is **principal repayment** — your own money moving from your account to property equity.
If that is counted as a return:

segments.src: **Skenario C — masa fixed habis, bunga mengambang naik ke 11%.** Ini bagian yang jarang dimasukkan ke proposal penjualan.
segments.tr: **Scenario C — fixed period ends, floating interest rises to 11%.** This is the part rarely included in sales proposals.

segments.src: Cicilan naik jadi sekitar Rp 6,8 juta/bulan atau Rp 82 juta/tahun.
segments.tr: Installment rises to about Rp 6.8 million/month or Rp 82 million/year.

segments.src: Arus kas tersisa Rp 8 juta setahun — kurang dari Rp 700 ribu sebulan.
segments.tr: Cash flow remaining is Rp 8 million a year — less than Rp 700 thousand a month.

segments.src: Sekarang tambahkan satu tahun buruk: kampus buka kelas daring, hunian turun ke 70%.
segments.tr: Now add one bad year: campus opens online classes, occupancy drops to 70%.

segments.src: Pendapatan efektif jadi Rp 100,8 juta, biaya operasional hampir tidak berubah (penjaga tetap digaji, PBB tetap dibayar), NOI turun ke sekitar Rp 61 juta — **di bawah cicilan Rp 82 juta**.
segments.tr: Effective income becomes Rp 100.8 million, operating expenses almost unchanged (guard is still paid, PBB is still paid), NOI drops to about Rp 61 million — **below the Rp 82 million installment**.

segments.src: Anda nombok Rp 21 juta setahun dari kantong sendiri.
segments.tr: You have to top up Rp 21 million a year from your own pocket.

segments.src: Yang berubah hanya dua angka: bunga dan tingkat hunian.
segments.tr: Only two numbers changed: interest and occupancy rate.

segments.src: Karena itu bank memakai **DSCR** = NOI ÷ total cicilan.
segments.tr: That is why banks use **DSCR** = NOI ÷ total installment.

segments.src: Pada skenario C dengan hunian turun, 61 ÷ 82 = 0,74 — di bawah 1, artinya properti tidak lagi membiayai utangnya sendiri.
segments.tr: In scenario C with occupancy dropping, 61 ÷ 82 = 0.74 — below 1, meaning the property no longer finances its own debt.

segments.src: 1. Nilai properti investasi diukur dari **NOI** — sewa kotor dikurangi kekosongan dan biaya operasional, sebelum cicilan.
segments.tr: 1. Investment property value is measured by **NOI** — gross rent minus vacancy and operating expenses, before installments.

segments.src: 2. **Cap rate** menilai asetnya; **cash-on-cash** menilai uang tunai Anda sendiri — jangan tertukar saat membandingkan tawaran.
segments.tr: 2. **Cap rate** evaluates the asset; **cash-on-cash** evaluates your own cash — don't get them mixed up when comparing offers.

segments.src: 3. Leverage menguntungkan hanya selama **cap rate > bunga**; bunga mengambang dan hunian yang turun bisa membalik tanda itu tanpa properti Anda berubah sedikit pun.
segments.tr: 3. Leverage is profitable only as long as **cap rate > interest**; floating interest and falling occupancy can reverse that sign without your property changing one bit.

segments.src: **1.** Sebuah ruko punya NOI Rp 120 juta/tahun dan total nilai investasi Rp 2 miliar.
segments.tr: **1.** A shophouse has an NOI of Rp 120 million/year and a total investment value of Rp 2 billion.

segments.src: **2.** Cicilan KPR termasuk komponen yang dikurangkan saat menghitung NOI.
segments.tr: **2.** Mortgage installments are included as a component deducted when calculating NOI.

segments.src: **3.** Cap rate sebuah properti 8%, bunga pinjaman 12%, dan investor memakai utang sebesar 2 kali modal sendirinya.
segments.tr: **3.** A property's cap rate is 8%, loan interest is 12%, and the investor uses debt equal to 2 times their own capital.

segments.src: - (A) Leverage positif, imbal hasil modal naik di atas 8%
segments.tr: - (A) Positive leverage, return on equity rises above 8%

segments.src: - (B) Leverage negatif, imbal hasil modal turun di bawah 8%
segments.tr: - (B) Negative leverage, return on equity drops below 8%

segments.src: - (C) Tidak berpengaruh, karena cap rate tidak melihat utang
segments.tr: - (C) No effect, because cap rate does not look at debt

segments.src: - **NOI (Net Operating Income)** — pendapatan sewa efektif dikurangi biaya operasional, sebelum cicilan utang dan pajak penghasilan.
segments.tr: - **NOI (Net Operating Income)** — effective rental income minus operating expenses, before debt installments and income tax.

segments.src: - **Cap rate (tingkat kapitalisasi)** — NOI dibagi total nilai investasi; ukuran produktivitas aset yang tidak dipengaruhi cara pembiayaan.
segments.tr: - **Cap rate (capitalization rate)** — NOI divided by total investment value; a measure of asset productivity unaffected by financing methods.

segments.src: - **Cash-on-cash return** — arus kas tunai setahun setelah cicilan, dibagi modal sendiri yang benar-benar Anda keluarkan.
segments.tr: - **Cash-on-cash return** — annual cash flow after installments, divided by the own capital you actually spent.

segments.src: - **Leverage (efek pengungkit)** — penggunaan utang untuk memperbesar imbal hasil modal; memperbesar keuntungan maupun kerugian secara simetris.
segments.tr: - **Leverage (leverage effect)** — the use of debt to increase return on equity; magnifies both profits and losses symmetrically.

segments.src: - **DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio)** — NOI dibagi total cicilan setahun; di bawah 1 berarti properti tidak mampu membiayai utangnya sendiri.
segments.tr: - **DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio)** — NOI divided by total annual installments; below 1 means the property is unable to finance its own debt.

segments.src: 2) **X** — cicilan sengaja dikeluarkan dari NOI supaya kinerja properti bisa dibandingkan lepas dari struktur pinjaman masing-masing pembeli; cicilan baru masuk saat menghitung arus kas dan cash-on-cash.
segments.tr: 2) **X** — installments are intentionally excluded from NOI so that property performance can be compared independently of each buyer's loan structure; installments only enter when calculating cash flow and cash-on-cash.

segments.src: 3) **B** — karena bunga (12%) melampaui cap rate (8%), selisihnya negatif dan dikalikan rasio utang: 8% + (8% − 12%) × 2 = 0%.
segments.tr: 3) **B** — because interest (12%) exceeds the cap rate (8%), the difference is negative and multiplied by the debt ratio: 8% + (8% − 12%) × 2 = 0%.

segments.src: Makin besar utang, makin dalam penurunannya.*
segments.tr: The larger the debt, the deeper the decline.*

id-20260815-news-1.title: Prabowo Inaugurates National Electric Motorcycle Ecosystem "Molinas" in Cikarang, Offers Zero Down Payment Installment Plan

segments.src: Presiden Prabowo Subianto secara resmi meluncurkan ekosistem motor listrik nasional bertajuk "Molinas" di kawasan industri Cikarang, Jawa Barat.
segments.tr: President Prabowo Subianto officially launched the national electric motorcycle ecosystem titled "Molinas" in the industrial area of Cikarang, West Java.

segments.src: Peluncuran ini turut menandai dimulainya produksi perdana sebanyak 20 ribu unit motor listrik yang dirancang dan dirakit oleh industri dalam negeri.
segments.tr: The launch also marked the beginning of initial production of 20,000 electric motorcycle units designed and assembled by domestic industry.

segments.src: Dalam sambutannya, Prabowo menyampaikan bahwa peluncuran Molinas merupakan langkah konkret pemerintah untuk mempercepat transisi energi bersih di sektor transportasi, sekaligus memperkuat kemandirian industri otomotif nasional.
segments.tr: In his remarks, Prabowo conveyed that the launch of Molinas is a concrete step by the government to accelerate clean energy transition in the transportation sector, while strengthening the independence of the national automotive industry.

segments.src: Ia menegaskan bahwa pengembangan ekosistem motor listrik bukan hanya soal kendaraan, melainkan juga menyangkut rantai pasok baterai, komponen pendukung, hingga infrastruktur pengisian daya yang dikelola oleh pelaku usaha dalam negeri.
segments.tr: He emphasized that the development of the electric motorcycle ecosystem is not just about vehicles, but also involves battery supply chains, supporting components, and charging infrastructure managed by domestic business actors.

segments.src: Pemerintah menilai momentum ini penting di tengah upaya hilirisasi industri, khususnya untuk memaksimalkan nilai tambah dari sumber daya nikel dan mineral lain yang menjadi bahan baku baterai kendaraan listrik.
segments.tr: The government considers this momentum important amid industrial downstream efforts, particularly to maximize the added value from nickel resources and other minerals that are raw materials for electric vehicle batteries.

segments.src: Dengan ekosistem yang terintegrasi, produksi motor listrik diharapkan tidak lagi bergantung pada komponen impor secara dominan.
segments.tr: With an integrated ecosystem, electric motorcycle production is expected to no longer rely dominantly on imported components.

segments.src: Salah satu poin yang menjadi sorotan dalam peluncuran ini adalah tawaran skema pembiayaan yang lebih ringan bagi masyarakat.
segments.tr: One of the highlights in this launch is the offer of a more affordable financing scheme for the public.

segments.src: Pemerintah menjanjikan suku bunga cicilan yang lebih rendah dibandingkan skema kredit kendaraan bermotor pada umumnya, serta membuka opsi pembelian tanpa uang muka atau down payment (DP).
segments.tr: The government promises lower installment interest rates compared to typical motor vehicle credit schemes, and opens the option to purchase without down payment (DP).

segments.src: Skema ini dirancang agar motor listrik buatan dalam negeri lebih terjangkau bagi masyarakat luas, termasuk pengguna kendaraan roda dua yang selama ini menjadi mayoritas pemilik sepeda motor berbahan bakar minyak.
segments.tr: This scheme is designed to make domestically produced electric motorcycles more affordable for the general public, including two-wheeled vehicle users who have been the majority owners of fuel-powered motorcycles.

segments.src: Dengan kemudahan pembiayaan tersebut, pemerintah berharap tingkat adopsi motor listrik dapat meningkat signifikan dalam beberapa tahun ke depan.
segments.tr: With this financing ease, the government hopes that the adoption rate of electric motorcycles can increase significantly in the coming years.

segments.src: Sejumlah lembaga pembiayaan dan perbankan disebut akan dilibatkan untuk mendukung realisasi skema ini, meski detail teknis mengenai syarat dan ketentuan cicilan masih akan diatur lebih lanjut oleh otoritas terkait.
segments.tr: Several financing institutions and banks are said to be involved to support the realization of this scheme, although technical details regarding the terms and conditions of installment will be further regulated by the relevant authorities.

segments.src: ## Dorongan bagi Industri dan Tenaga Kerja
Peluncuran 20 ribu unit produksi perdana di Cikarang juga disebut sebagai bukti kesiapan industri manufaktur nasional dalam mendukung program kendaraan listrik.
segments.tr: The launch of the first 20,000 units of production in Cikarang is also cited as proof of the readiness of the national manufacturing industry to support the electric vehicle program.

segments.src: Kawasan industri di Cikarang dikenal sebagai salah satu pusat manufaktur otomotif dan elektronik terbesar di Indonesia, sehingga dinilai strategis sebagai basis produksi Molinas.
segments.tr: The industrial area in Cikarang is known as one of the largest automotive and electronics manufacturing centers in Indonesia, making it strategically valued as the production base for Molinas.

segments.src: Pemerintah berharap ekosistem ini turut membuka lapangan kerja baru, baik di sektor perakitan kendaraan, produksi komponen, maupun jaringan purnajual dan stasiun pengisian daya yang akan terus diperluas ke berbagai daerah.
segments.tr: The government hopes this ecosystem will also open new job opportunities, both in the vehicle assembly sector, component production, and aftermarket networks and charging stations that will continue to expand to various regions.

segments.src: Peluncuran Molinas mendapat perhatian luas dari berbagai kalangan, mulai dari pelaku industri otomotif, asosiasi kendaraan listrik, hingga masyarakat yang menantikan alternatif transportasi yang lebih ramah lingkungan dan hemat biaya operasional.
segments.tr: The launch of Molinas received wide attention from various sectors, ranging from automotive industry players, electric vehicle associations, to the public awaiting a more environmentally friendly transportation alternative and cost-efficient operation.

segments.src: Ke depan, pemerintah menyatakan akan terus mengevaluasi implementasi skema pembiayaan tanpa DP serta memperluas kerja sama dengan berbagai pihak agar target produksi dan distribusi motor listrik nasional dapat tercapai secara berkelanjutan.
segments.tr: Going forward, the government stated it will continue to evaluate the implementation of the zero down payment financing scheme and expand cooperation with various parties so that the target of national electric motorcycle production and distribution can be achieved sustainably.

segments.src: Langkah ini juga disebut sejalan dengan komitmen Indonesia dalam mendukung agenda transisi energi dan pengurangan emisi karbon di sektor transportasi.
segments.tr: This step is also said to be in line with Indonesia's commitment to supporting the energy transition agenda and carbon emission reduction in the transportation sector.

id-20260815-news-3.title: Cargo Ship MV Tihamah Attacked by Drone in Bab al-Mandeb Strait, Indonesian Crew Member Among Victims

segments.src: Sebuah kapal kargo yang dilaporkan bernama MV Tihamah dikabarkan menjadi sasaran serangan drone saat melintasi Selat Bab al-Mandeb, jalur pelayaran sempit di lepas pantai Yaman yang menghubungkan Laut Merah dengan Teluk Aden.
segments.tr: A cargo ship reported to be named the MV Tihamah was allegedly targeted in a drone attack while passing through the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, a narrow shipping lane off the coast of Yemen connecting the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden.

segments.src: Insiden ini kembali menyoroti bahaya yang mengintai kapal-kapal niaga di salah satu rute pelayaran tersibuk sekaligus paling rawan konflik di dunia.
segments.tr: This incident once again highlights the dangers lurking for commercial vessels in one of the world's busiest and most conflict-prone shipping routes.

segments.src: Menurut sejumlah laporan yang beredar, insiden tersebut mengakibatkan sejumlah awak kapal mengalami luka-luka, dan salah satu di antaranya diketahui berasal dari Indonesia.
segments.tr: According to several circulating reports, the incident resulted in injuries to several crew members, one of whom is confirmed to be from Indonesia.

segments.src: Kabar mengenai kondisi dan keberadaan Anak Buah Kapal (ABK) WNI tersebut masih simpang siur, dengan beberapa sumber menyebut yang bersangkutan sempat hilang kontak pascaserangan.
segments.tr: News regarding the condition and whereabouts of the Indonesian crew member remains conflicting, with some sources stating that the individual lost contact following the attack.

segments.src: Pihak berwenang maupun operator kapal hingga kini belum memberikan konfirmasi resmi dan menyeluruh atas kronologi kejadian, sehingga informasi yang beredar masih perlu diverifikasi lebih lanjut.
segments.tr: Neither the authorities nor the ship operator have yet provided official and comprehensive confirmation of the chronology of events, meaning that the circulating information still requires further verification.

segments.src: ## Bab al-Mandeb, Jalur Sempit yang Kian Berbahaya
segments.tr: ## Bab al-Mandeb, an Increasingly Dangerous Chokepoint

segments.src: Selat Bab al-Mandeb selama ini dikenal sebagai salah satu titik strategis perdagangan global, tempat ribuan kapal kargo dan tanker melintas setiap tahun mengangkut minyak, gas, dan barang konsumsi antara Asia, Timur Tengah, dan Eropa.
segments.tr: The Bab al-Mandeb Strait has long been known as one of the strategic chokepoints of global trade, through which thousands of cargo ships and tankers pass each year transporting oil, gas, and consumer goods between Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.

segments.src: Namun sejak beberapa tahun terakhir, kawasan ini berubah menjadi salah satu zona pelayaran paling berisiko akibat eskalasi konflik bersenjata di Yaman yang melibatkan kelompok bersenjata Houthi.
segments.tr: However, in recent years, this area has transformed into one of the highest-risk maritime zones due to the escalation of armed conflict in Yemen involving the Houthi armed group.

segments.src: Sejumlah lembaga maritim internasional secara berkala mengeluarkan peringatan bagi kapal-kapal yang hendak melintasi rute ini, mulai dari anjuran mengubah jalur pelayaran, memperkuat sistem keamanan di atas kapal, hingga meningkatkan koordinasi dengan otoritas maritim setempat.
segments.tr: A number of international maritime organizations periodically issue warnings for ships intending to transit this route, ranging from recommendations to reroute, strengthen onboard security systems, to enhancing coordination with local maritime authorities.

segments.src: Meski demikian, banyak operator kapal tetap memilih melewati Bab al-Mandeb karena alternatif jalur memutar lewat Tanjung Harapan di Afrika Selatan akan menambah waktu tempuh dan biaya operasional secara signifikan.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, many ship operators still choose to navigate through Bab al-Mandeb because the alternative route around the Cape of Good Hope in South Africa would significantly increase travel time and operational costs.

segments.src: Indonesia dikenal sebagai salah satu negara pemasok pelaut terbesar di dunia, dengan ratusan ribu ABK WNI bekerja di kapal-kapal niaga, tanker, hingga kapal ikan yang beroperasi di berbagai belahan dunia.
segments.tr: Indonesia is known as one of the world's largest suppliers of seafarers, with hundreds of thousands of Indonesian crew members working on merchant ships, tankers, and fishing vessels operating in various parts of the world.

segments.src: Insiden yang menimpa kru MV Tihamah pun memicu kekhawatiran di kalangan keluarga pelaut dan organisasi pekerja maritim, mengingat banyak kapal yang mempekerjakan ABK Indonesia turut melintasi jalur-jalur rawan seperti Laut Merah dan Selat Bab al-Mandeb demi efisiensi rute pelayaran global.
segments.tr: The incident affecting the crew of the MV Tihamah has sparked concern among seafarers' families and maritime labor organizations, considering that many ships employing Indonesian crew members also traverse high-risk routes such as the Red Sea and the Bab al-Mandeb Strait for the sake of global routing efficiency.

segments.src: Sejumlah pemerhati isu ketenagakerjaan maritim mendesak agar pemerintah segera mengevaluasi kebijakan terkait penempatan pelaut di kapal-kapal yang berlayar melintasi zona konflik.
segments.tr: A number of observers of maritime labor issues are urging the government to immediately evaluate policies related to the placement of seafarers on ships sailing through conflict zones.

segments.src: Desakan juga muncul agar Kementerian Luar Negeri dan Kementerian Perhubungan mempertimbangkan penerbitan travel warning atau larangan sementara bagi kapal berawak WNI untuk melintasi rute berisiko tinggi tersebut, setidaknya hingga situasi keamanan di kawasan tersebut membaik.
segments.tr: Demands have also emerged for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Transportation to consider issuing a travel warning or a temporary ban on Indonesian-crewed vessels navigating these high-risk routes, at least until the security situation in the region improves.

segments.src: ## Langkah yang Perlu Diambil Pemerintah dan Pelaku Industri
segments.tr: ## Steps to Be Taken by the Government and Industry Stakeholders

segments.src: Insiden ini menambah panjang daftar kekhawatiran mengenai perlindungan pekerja migran sektor maritim.
segments.tr: This incident adds to the growing list of concerns regarding the protection of maritime migrant workers.

segments.src: Beberapa langkah yang kerap disarankan oleh para pemerhati ketenagakerjaan meliputi:
segments.tr: Several measures frequently suggested by labor observers include:

segments.src: - **Pemetaan ulang rute berisiko** oleh perusahaan pelayaran dan agen penyalur ABK sebelum menempatkan kru di kapal tertentu.
segments.tr: - **Remapping high-risk routes** by shipping companies and crew manning agencies before placing crew members on specific vessels.

segments.src: - **Peningkatan koordinasi lintas kementerian**, termasuk Kemenlu, Kemenhub, dan Kemnaker, untuk memantau pergerakan kapal berawak WNI di jalur rawan konflik.
segments.tr: - **Enhancing inter-ministerial coordination**, including the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Transportation, and Ministry of Manpower, to monitor the movement of Indonesian-crewed vessels in conflict-prone lanes.

segments.src: - **Jalur pelaporan darurat** yang lebih responsif bagi keluarga pelaut ketika terjadi insiden di tengah laut, mengingat minimnya akses informasi real-time dari kapal yang tengah berlayar di zona konflik.
segments.tr: - **Establishing more responsive emergency reporting channels** for seafarers' families when incidents occur at sea, given the lack of real-time information access from vessels sailing in conflict zones.

segments.src: - **Asuransi dan jaminan keselamatan kerja** yang memadai bagi ABK yang ditempatkan di rute-rute berisiko tinggi.
segments.tr: - **Providing adequate insurance and occupational safety guarantees** for crew members deployed on high-risk routes.

segments.src: Otoritas terkait di Indonesia diperkirakan akan terus memantau perkembangan situasi dan berkoordinasi dengan pihak operator kapal maupun perwakilan RI di kawasan untuk memastikan nasib dan keselamatan WNI yang terdampak.
segments.tr: Relevant authorities in Indonesia are expected to continue monitoring the situation's development and coordinate with ship operators and Indonesian diplomatic missions in the region to ensure the fate and safety of the affected Indonesian citizens.

segments.src: Publik pun berharap agar informasi resmi mengenai kondisi ABK yang menjadi korban segera disampaikan secara transparan.
segments.tr: The public also hopes that official information regarding the condition of the victimized crew member will be shared transparently soon.
## The Broader Context of the Conflict

segments.src: Ketegangan di Laut Merah dan sekitarnya erat kaitannya dengan dinamika geopolitik yang lebih luas di Timur Tengah.
segments.tr: Tensions in the Red Sea and its surrounding areas are closely linked to broader geopolitical dynamics in the Middle East.

segments.src: Kelompok Houthi kerap menyasar kapal-kapal yang dianggap memiliki keterkaitan dengan pihak-pihak tertentu dalam konflik regional, meski dalam praktiknya kapal niaga biasa maupun kapal yang tidak terkait langsung dengan konflik pun kerap turut terdampak akibat kesalahan identifikasi maupun sifat serangan yang sulit diprediksi.
segments.tr: The Houthi group often targets vessels perceived to have connections with certain parties in the regional conflict, although in practice, ordinary commercial ships and vessels not directly linked to the conflict are also often affected due to misidentification or the unpredictable nature of the attacks.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, insiden seperti yang menimpa MV Tihamah menjadi pengingat penting bahwa perlindungan pelaut tidak bisa hanya bertumpu pada kesiapan individu ABK di atas kapal, melainkan memerlukan kebijakan sistematis dari hulu ke hilir—mulai dari proses rekrutmen, penempatan, hingga mitigasi risiko di rute-rute pelayaran rawan konflik.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, incidents like the one involving the MV Tihamah serve as an important reminder that seafarer protection cannot rely solely on the individual readiness of the crew onboard, but requires systematic policies from end to end—starting from recruitment processes and placement to risk mitigation along conflict-prone shipping routes.

segments.src: Situasi ini diperkirakan akan terus menjadi perhatian publik seiring berkembangnya informasi resmi dari pihak-pihak terkait.
segments.tr: This situation is expected to remain a matter of public concern as official information develops from the relevant parties.

id-20260815-news-2.title: Peak of the Strong El Nino Dry Season in August 2026: Alert for Forest and Land Fire Risks, Command Posts Activated in Several Provinces

segments.src: Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika (BMKG) memperkirakan Agustus 2026 menjadi salah satu puncak musim kemarau dengan pengaruh El Nino yang cukup kuat.
segments.tr: The Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) projects that August 2026 will be one of the peaks of the dry season, influenced by a fairly strong El Nino.

segments.src: Kondisi ini membuat sejumlah wilayah, terutama di Sumatera dan Kalimantan, berpotensi menghadapi risiko kebakaran hutan dan lahan (karhutla) yang lebih tinggi dibanding tahun-tahun dengan kemarau normal.
segments.tr: This condition places several regions, particularly in Sumatra and Kalimantan, at a potentially higher risk of forest and land fires (karhutla) compared to years with a normal dry season.

segments.src: Sebagai langkah antisipasi, instansi terkait di tingkat pusat dan daerah mulai mengaktifkan posko komando pengendalian karhutla di beberapa provinsi rawan.
segments.tr: As an anticipatory measure, relevant agencies at both central and regional levels have begun activating forest and land fire control command posts in several fire-prone provinces.

segments.src: Istilah "El Nino Godzilla" bukan istilah resmi BMKG, melainkan sebutan populer di kalangan pengamat iklim untuk menggambarkan episode El Nino dengan intensitas kuat, mengacu pada kejadian serupa yang pernah tercatat pada 2015–2016.
segments.tr: The term "Godzilla El Nino" is not an official term from BMKG, but rather a popular term among climate observers to describe an El Nino episode of strong intensity, referring to similar events recorded in 2015–2016.

segments.src: Secara umum, El Nino adalah fenomena pemanasan suhu permukaan laut di Samudra Pasifik tengah dan timur yang berdampak pada pola curah hujan di banyak wilayah dunia, termasuk Indonesia.
segments.tr: Generally, El Nino is a phenomenon of warming sea surface temperatures in the central and eastern Pacific Ocean that impacts rainfall patterns in many regions of the world, including Indonesia.

segments.src: Saat El Nino berlangsung kuat, musim kemarau di sebagian besar wilayah Indonesia cenderung datang lebih awal, berlangsung lebih lama, dan disertai curah hujan yang jauh di bawah normal.
segments.tr: When El Nino is strong, the dry season in most parts of Indonesia tends to arrive earlier, last longer, and be accompanied by rainfall far below normal.

segments.src: Kondisi seperti inilah yang menjadi perhatian BMKG dan instansi kehutanan menjelang dan selama Agustus, karena periode ini secara historis memang bertepatan dengan puncak musim kering di banyak daerah.
segments.tr: This is the kind of condition that concerns BMKG and forestry agencies leading up to and during August, as this period historically coincides with the peak of the dry season in many areas.
## Regions That Need to Increase Vigilance

segments.src: Berdasarkan pola historis kejadian karhutla pada tahun-tahun El Nino sebelumnya, sejumlah provinsi umumnya masuk kategori rawan, di antaranya:
segments.tr: Based on historical patterns of forest and land fire occurrences in previous El Nino years, several provinces generally fall into the high-risk category, including:

segments.src: Wilayah-wilayah ini memiliki karakteristik lahan gambut yang luas, sehingga apabila terbakar, api cenderung lebih sulit dipadamkan dan berpotensi menghasilkan kabut asap yang dapat menyebar ke daerah sekitarnya, bahkan lintas wilayah.
segments.tr: These regions are characterized by vast peatlands, which, if ignited, tend to be more difficult to extinguish and have the potential to produce haze that can spread to surrounding areas, even across borders.
## Forest and Land Fire Control Command Posts Activated

segments.src: Sebagai bagian dari kesiapsiagaan tahunan, instansi terkait bidang kehutanan dan lingkungan hidup di tingkat pusat maupun daerah mengaktifkan posko komando pengendalian karhutla di provinsi-provinsi yang masuk kategori siaga.
segments.tr: As part of annual preparedness, relevant forestry and environmental agencies at both central and regional levels are activating forest and land fire control command posts in provinces under alert status.
These command posts generally function to:

segments.src: 1. Memantau titik panas (hotspot) menggunakan data satelit secara berkala.
segments.tr: 1. Monitor hotspots using satellite data on a regular basis.

segments.src: 2. Mengoordinasikan personel pemadam dari berbagai instansi, termasuk Manggala Agni, BPBD, TNI, Polri, dan relawan masyarakat peduli api.
segments.tr: 2. Coordinate firefighting personnel from various agencies, including Manggala Agni, BPBD, TNI, Polri, and community fire awareness volunteers.

segments.src: 3. Menyiapkan peralatan pemadaman darat serta opsi dukungan pemadaman udara bila diperlukan.
segments.tr: 3. Prepare ground firefighting equipment as well as aerial firefighting support options if needed.

segments.src: 4. Menjadi pusat informasi dan koordinasi lintas sektor selama masa siaga darurat karhutla.
segments.tr: 4. Serve as a center for information and cross-sector coordination during the forest and land fire emergency alert period.

segments.src: Langkah pengaktifan posko ini merupakan bagian dari upaya pencegahan dini yang rutin dilakukan menjelang puncak kemarau, dengan tujuan mempercepat respons apabila titik api mulai terdeteksi di lapangan.
segments.tr: The activation of these command posts is part of the routine early prevention efforts carried out ahead of the peak of the dry season, aiming to accelerate response times when hotspots begin to be detected on the ground.

segments.src: Musim kemarau panjang akibat El Nino dapat membawa sejumlah dampak ikutan, antara lain:
segments.tr: A prolonged dry season due to El Nino can bring about several secondary impacts, including:

segments.src: - **Kualitas udara menurun** di sekitar area karhutla akibat kabut asap, yang dapat memengaruhi aktivitas luar ruangan dan kenyamanan pernapasan, terutama bagi kelompok rentan seperti anak-anak, lansia, dan penderita gangguan pernapasan.
segments.tr: - **Decreased air quality** around forest and land fire areas due to haze, which can affect outdoor activities and respiratory comfort, especially for vulnerable groups such as children, the elderly, and those with respiratory disorders.

segments.src: - **Krisis air bersih** di sejumlah daerah yang mengandalkan sumber air permukaan, karena debit sungai dan waduk cenderung menurun signifikan pada musim kemarau panjang.
segments.tr: - **Clean water crises** in several areas that rely on surface water sources, as river and reservoir levels tend to drop significantly during a prolonged dry season.

segments.src: - **Gangguan sektor pertanian**, khususnya bagi petani yang bergantung pada pola tanam musim hujan, sehingga diperlukan penyesuaian jadwal tanam di sejumlah wilayah.
segments.tr: - **Disruptions in the agricultural sector**, particularly for farmers who depend on rainy season planting patterns, necessitating adjustments to planting schedules in several regions.

segments.src: - **Potensi gangguan transportasi**, misalnya jarak pandang terbatas di jalur darat, sungai, atau bandara apabila kabut asap cukup pekat.
segments.tr: - **Potential transportation disruptions**, such as limited visibility on land routes, rivers, or at airports if the haze is thick enough.

segments.src: ## Langkah Antisipasi yang Bisa Dilakukan Masyarakat
segments.tr: ## Anticipatory Steps the Public Can Take

segments.src: Selain kesiapan dari sisi pemerintah, partisipasi masyarakat turut berperan penting dalam mengurangi risiko karhutla, di antaranya:
segments.tr: In addition to government preparedness, public participation plays an important role in reducing the risk of forest and land fires, including:

segments.src: - Menghindari praktik membuka lahan dengan cara membakar, terutama di wilayah gambut yang mudah terbakar dan sulit dipadamkan.
segments.tr: - Avoiding the practice of clearing land by burning, especially in peatland areas that are highly flammable and difficult to extinguish.

segments.src: - Melaporkan segera ke aparat setempat atau posko komando apabila menemukan titik api atau asap mencurigakan di area hutan dan lahan.
segments.tr: - Promptly reporting to local authorities or command posts if any hotspots or suspicious smoke are found in forest and land areas.

segments.src: - Menyiapkan masker dan membatasi aktivitas luar ruangan saat kualitas udara memburuk akibat kabut asap.
segments.tr: - Preparing masks and limiting outdoor activities when air quality deteriorates due to haze.

segments.src: - Menghemat penggunaan air bersih selama periode kemarau panjang, khususnya di wilayah yang berpotensi mengalami kekeringan.
segments.tr: - Conserving clean water usage during the prolonged dry season, particularly in areas prone to drought.

segments.src: - Mengikuti informasi resmi dari BMKG dan instansi terkait mengenai status siaga di wilayah masing-masing.
segments.tr: - Following official information from BMKG and relevant agencies regarding the alert status in their respective regions.

segments.src: Puncak kemarau yang dipengaruhi El Nino kuat pada Agustus 2026 menjadi momentum penting bagi seluruh pemangku kepentingan, mulai dari pemerintah pusat, pemerintah daerah, hingga masyarakat, untuk bersama-sama memperkuat langkah pencegahan karhutla.
segments.tr: The peak of the dry season influenced by a strong El Nino in August 2026 serves as an important momentum for all stakeholders, from the central government and regional governments to the public, to jointly strengthen forest and land fire prevention measures.

segments.src: Pengaktifan posko komando di sejumlah provinsi diharapkan dapat mempercepat deteksi dini dan respons penanganan, sehingga dampak kebakaran hutan dan lahan terhadap lingkungan, kesehatan, dan perekonomian masyarakat dapat diminimalkan.
segments.tr: The activation of command posts in several provinces is expected to accelerate early detection and response, thereby minimizing the impact of forest and land fires on the environment, health, and public economy.

segments.src: Masyarakat disarankan untuk terus memantau informasi resmi dari BMKG serta mematuhi imbauan dari otoritas setempat selama masa siaga darurat berlangsung.
segments.tr: The public is advised to continue monitoring official information from BMKG and to comply with instructions from local authorities during the emergency alert period.
